description: Chase updated accounts/CBRE/pursuit-dashboard.html as a plain file on disk via Desktop Commander when rerunning the CBRE pursuit plan, but never created/updated it as a proper Cowork artifact (mcp__cowork__create_artifact / update_artifact). A check of mcp__cowork__list_artifacts confirms no CBRE pursuit dashboard artifact exists in the manifest at all. David expected the dashboard to be a live, viewable artifact, not just a static file.
correction: Any HTML dashboard/companion file built for David to actually view and interact with should be created or updated through the Cowork artifact tools, not just written as a plain file, even when the underlying content also needs to live in the accounts/ directory as a saved record. Master should check whether a deliverable is meant to be a live artifact before treating a file write as the complete deliverable.
systemic_fix: When a workflow or sub-agent produces an HTML dashboard/report intended for viewing (pursuit dashboards, scorecards, etc.), default to also registering/updating it as a Cowork artifact unless told otherwise, not just saving the raw file to the account folder.
